comparison_with_previous.note: Task contract reset; previous v0/v1 numbers were toy FP32 MoE and are not comparable.

optimization.action_description: Replace toy FP32 MoE task with FlashInfer-compatible packed FP4 block-scale MoE API and scalar CUDA baseline.
optimization.expected_impact: PES candidates now optimize the requested operator surface instead of the earlier local toy shape.
optimization.risks_and_rollback: Scalar CUDA is slow and supports bf16 hidden states only; rollback by restoring pre-alignment kernel.py/reference.py/src/test_kernel.py.

profile_evidence.evidence_summary: Smoke profile PASS on NVIDIA L20D for E_global=512, top_k=10, H=128, I=64, E_local=16.
profile_evidence.evidence_chain: one scalar thread computes a full FP4-dequantized expert path per output element -> correctness baseline only -> grouped/tiled CUDA is required for production Qwen dimensions
